config_notes: Unfiltered EID 3 network connection and EID 22 DNS query.

defender.notes: The Defender service/engine remained installed, while real-time and behavior monitoring were confirmed off before execution.

network_and_dns.details: No network connection or DNS query event occurred in the canonical collection window.

files.details: Windows svchost.exe emitted EID 23 then EID 11 while replacing C:\Windows\Prefetch\MIMIKATZ.EXE-A381AD0F.pf immediately after process termination. No direct mimikatz file write was observed.

registry.details: The window contained 133 EID 12 and 7 EID 13 background events from svchost.exe/taskhostw.exe, zero EID 14, and no event attributed to the mimikatz ProcessGuid or image.

process_identity_and_command.details: Image, path, OriginalFileName=mimikatz.exe, command line with privilege::debug and sekurlsa::logonpasswords, user, integrity level, and hashes were recorded.

parent_child.details: PowerShell PID 1224 launched mimikatz PID 4452 as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.

observed_techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
observed_techniques.observation: Sysmon EID 10 recorded mimikatz opening lsass.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1010, including PROCESS_VM_READ.

evidence.description: Sanitized event fields and honest presence/absence findings for all five observation dimensions.
Sanitized Sysmon ProcessAccess event showing mimikatz opening LSASS with GrantedAccess 0x1010.

sigma.description: Primary portable detection for mimikatz OriginalFileName or characteristic double-colon credential-module command lines with parent context.
Supplemental portable file-event detection for the name-dependent Prefetch artifact observed in the run.
Deep Sysmon-native detection for memory-read-capable LSASS access masks independent of mimikatz identity.

sanitization.notes: Native mimikatz output was discarded on the VM and never pulled or inspected. Only Sigma-relevant telemetry fields are committed; no recovered credentials or LSASS-derived hashes are present.
